# Klarna (18 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /product | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get a Klarna product by id or URL |
| /product/offers | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | List merchant offers for a Klarna product |
| /search | `query` | 5 | Search Klarna products by keyword |
| /search/suggestions | `query` | 1 | Get Klarna search suggestions |
| /reviews | `product_id` / `url` | **5-9** | Get Klarna user reviews for a product |
| /reviews/pro | `product_id` / `url` | **5-9** | Get Klarna professional reviews for a product |
| /reviews/overview | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get Klarna review totals and score distributions |
| /product/price-history | `product_id` / `url` | 5 | Get Klarna price history for a product |
| /product/compare | `product_id`, `product_id_2` | 5 | Compare two Klarna products |
| /category | `category_id` | 5 | Browse Klarna products in a category |
| /categories | `region`? | 1 | List Klarna root categories |
| /categories/children | `category_id` | 1 | Get Klarna sub-categories |
| /category/filters | `category_id` | 1 | Get Klarna filters for a category |
| /category/keywords | `category_id` | 1 | Get popular Klarna search keywords for a category |
| /category/guide | `category_id` | 1 | Get Klarna buying-guide content for a category |
| /stores | `region`?, `size`?, `offset`?, `categories`?, … | 1 | List Klarna shopping stores |
| /store/products | `id` | 5 | List products from a Klarna store |
| /store/filters | `id` | 1 | Get Klarna filters for a store page |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- `a`? — the spec marks nothing required, but these are the parameters the endpoint accepts;
  a bare call usually will not work. See Endpoint Details for which combination to send.
- *(none)* — takes no parameters at all.
- A method prefix (**POST**, **DELETE**, **PATCH**) marks a non-GET endpoint; unmarked rows are GET.
- Every endpoint also accepts the `Cache-Control` header (send `no-cache` to bypass the
  response cache — billed at the normal rate) and `Idempotency-Key` (a UUID that makes a
  retry safe; a replay returns the cached payload without double-billing).

## Endpoint Details

_What each endpoint returns and when to reach for it._

### /product — 5cr

Returns one Klarna shopping product: title, description, brand, rating, review count, and specifications. This payload has no list price; call GET /v1/klarna/product/offers for merchant prices. Pass the numeric product id plus category_id (cl94), or pass the full shopping URL and both ids are extracted. Ghost ids return 404 and are not billed.

**Parameters**

- `category_id` *(optional)*: Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/product?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product/offers — 5cr

Returns the merchant offers Klarna compared for one product, each with seller name, price, currency, stock status, and shipping cost. AirPods 4 had 40 offers across 19 merchants on 2026-09-02, cheapest Walmart at 110 USD. Ghost ids return 404 and are not billed.

**Parameters**

- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/product/offers?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search — 5cr

Returns Klarna shopping products matching a keyword, 20 per call, each with product id, title, category, lowest price, rating, and image. Pagination params are not honoured by upstream. A query that matches nothing is returned as an empty page and is not billed.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Search keyword, for example headphone or airpods.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/search?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /search/suggestions — 1cr

Returns Klarna search autocomplete: matching products plus category and feature suggestions for a partial query.

**Parameters**

- `query`: Partial search query to autocomplete, for example headphone.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/search/suggestions?query=<query>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews — 5-9cr

Returns written user reviews aggregated across merchants, 10 per page by default, each with text, star rating, title, reviewer name, source domain, and date. Pagination is clean: page 2 of AirPods 4 had 0 overlapping extracts with page 1. Pass the returned cursor back until has_more is false.

> ⚠️ **Metered: 5-9 credits a call — budget the 9 ceiling, not the low end.** Vendor label: 5-9 (metered): 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.

**Parameters**

- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `limit` *(optional)*: Reviews per page, 1 to 50. Default 10.
- `nextBatchId` *(optional)*: Pagination token from the previous page. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `label` *(optional)*: Optional CSV of SocialCrawl labels to add to every review. Without this param every page already carries sentiment and issue, free; label= adds the labels you name to them (the defaults keep running). sentiment and issue are free when asked for too; reports, incentivized and injection add 1 credit per started 25 newly judged reviews. judgments=off (or label=none) turns the default labels off. They read the review's title and text, never its stars. sentiment: how the reviewer feels, on five levels (level 0 to 4, score_0_1, confidence), plus rating_mismatch, true when the words clearly contradict the star rating (a glowing text under 1 star, a furious one under 5), null when the review has no rating. issue: the main problem the review reports (label: product_defect, sizing_or_fit, shipping_or_delivery, customer_service, price_or_value, missing_feature, other, or none, with confidence; label is null when unsure). reports (needs reports=): does this review say that the thing you describe happened (p, 0 to 1). incentivized: does the reviewer say they got the product free, discounted or rewarded for the review (p), and did the text carry a disclosure such as 'in exchange for my honest review', Vine or 체험단 (disclosed). injection flags text that addresses an AI system and tries to direct it (flagged, p); it never drops or rewrites a row. These are signals to read, never a verdict on a review or a reviewer. A review that could not be judged carries labels: null. Reviews already labelled for anyone are free, and so is a cached page. data.labels reports what was judged and billed.
- `reports` *(optional)*: Required by label=reports, ignored otherwise. What to look for, in plain words, up to 300 characters, for example reports=the battery drains quickly or reports=배송이 늦음. Every review gains labels.reports.p, the probability that it says so, in any wording or language. Without it label=reports is skipped with the warning label_reports_needs_reports and is not billed.
- `judgments` *(optional)*: Optional, on (the default) or off. By default every row gains free SocialCrawl judgments (computed.labels, and computed.relevance on search endpoints), reported in data.labels (mode default) and data.relevance (origin default), each with a status (complete, partial or skipped) and pending: the rows still being judged when the page was sent, which carry null now and are filled on your next call or cached read. Default judgments never add credits, never change an existing field, and never drop or reorder a row. off returns the page exactly as before, with none of those keys. label=none does the same.
- `dry_run` *(optional)*: Optional. When 1, return a cost preview for this labelled or relevance-filtered request without fetching the page or judging any row. data.estimate reports rows_expected, rows_cached, label_credits_min, label_credits_max and base_credits. 0 credits charged.
- `label_evidence` *(optional)*: Optional, only with label=. When 1, every labelled row also carries computed.labels_evidence.<preset> = { quote, sentence_index }: the sentence in the row that most clearly shows the label, copied verbatim. Absent or null when no single sentence shows it.
- `fit` *(optional)*: Optional. When goal, keep the rows and fields needed for the goal you pass in goal= (plus any that are uncertain, and the first and last), and replace the rest with a stub. data.held_back lists the held ids and a recall id that re-reads the full page from cache at no extra charge. Without this param the page is unchanged.
- `goal` *(optional)*: Required by fit=goal. What you are trying to do, in your own words, up to 300 characters.
- `fit_tokens` *(optional)*: Optional, only with fit=goal. Soft cap on how much of the page to keep, in tokens. Uncertain blocks and the first and last block are kept even if they exceed it.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `nextBatchId` (cursor style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/reviews?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /reviews/overview — 5cr

  - `url`: Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)


### /product/price-history — 5cr

Returns historical merchant prices for a product: lowest, highest, currency, per-merchant time series, and the merchant directory. interval is ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS (default), or INFINITE_DAYS.

**Parameters**

- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `interval` *(optional)*: History window: ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS (default), or INFINITE_DAYS.
- `product_id` / `url` — at least one required.
  - `product_id`: Klarna product id, the numeric id in a shopping URL: klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/... is product id 3331931731. Product ids also come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/search and GET /v1/klarna/category. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)
  - `url`: Full Klarna shopping URL, for example https://www.klarna.com/us/shopping/pl/cl94/3331931731/Headphones/Apple-AirPods-4-with-Active-Noise-Cancellation-White/. The product id and category id are extracted from the path. (one of: product_id, url; at least one required)

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/product/price-history?product_id=<product_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /product/compare — 5cr

Returns two Klarna products side by side: title, brand, rating, lowest price, and image. Pass two product ids from search or category.

**Parameters**

- `product_id`: First Klarna product id.
- `product_id_2`: Second Klarna product id.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/product/compare?product_id=<product_id>&product_id_2=<product_id_2>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /category — 5cr

Returns products in a Klarna category, 48 per page by default, each with product id, title, lowest price, rating, and image. Pagination is clean: page 2 of Headphones had 24 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. Feed a category id from GET /v1/klarna/categories.

**Parameters**

- `category_id`: Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `size` *(optional)*: Products per page, 1 to 100. Default 48.
- `offset` *(optional)*: Row offset, starting at 0. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: popularity (default), price_low, price_high, trend, name, rating, or price_drop.
- `price_range` *(optional)*: Price filter as min-max, for example 50-500, or 50- for 50 and above.
- `filter` *(optional)*: Facet filter as keyID-valueID from GET /v1/klarna/category/filters.
- `category_path_id` *(optional)*: Sub-category path id as keyID-valueID.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `offset` (offset style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/category?category_id=<category_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /categories — 1cr

Returns Klarna's browse taxonomy for a region: each node's id, display name, and children. Feed a node id into GET /v1/klarna/category to walk products, or GET /v1/klarna/categories/children for the next level.

**Parameters**

- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/categories" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /categories/children — 1cr

Returns one Klarna category and its children. t1 (TV and Audio) returned Headphones as cl94. Unknown category ids return 404 and are not billed.

**Parameters**

- `category_id`: Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/categories/children?category_id=<category_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

- `category_path_id` *(optional)*: Optional sub-category path id as keyID-valueID.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/category/filters?category_id=<category_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

- `category_id`: Klarna category id, for example cl94 for Headphones or t1 for TV and Audio. Ids come from GET /v1/klarna/categories and from search rows as category.id. Required for GET /v1/klarna/product when you pass product_id instead of a shopping URL.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `size` *(optional)*: Number of guiding items, 1 to 20. Default 4.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/category/guide?category_id=<category_id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /stores — 1cr

Returns Klarna's retailer directory, 24 per page, each with store UUID, display name, Klarna store URL, icons, and checkout flags. Pagination is clean: page 2 had 24 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. USA totalHits was 10000 on 2026-09-02. Optional filters: categories (fashion, travel), cashback, shop_in_app, klarna_at_checkout.

**Parameters**

- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `size` *(optional)*: Stores per page, 1 to 100. Default 24.
- `offset` *(optional)*: Row offset, starting at 0. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `categories` *(optional)*: Store category filter, for example fashion or travel.
- `cashback` *(optional)*: When true, keep stores that offer cashback.
- `shop_in_app` *(optional)*: When true, keep stores available in the Klarna app.
- `klarna_at_checkout` *(optional)*: When true, keep stores with Klarna at checkout.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `offset` (offset style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/stores" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /store/products — 5cr

Returns products sold by one Klarna retailer, 25 per page by default. Pagination is clean: Walmart page 2 had 25 new ids and zero overlap with page 1. Unknown store ids return an empty page and are not billed.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Klarna store UUID, the last segment of storeKrn: 09f4d635-0452-4f63-9455-c45420d95669 for Walmart US. Ids come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/stores.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.
- `size` *(optional)*: Products per page, 1 to 100. Default 25.
- `offset` *(optional)*: Row offset, starting at 0. Prefer the universal cursor parameter. Native upstream cursor param. Send the universal `cursor` instead: the API maps it to this name for you.
- `sort_by` *(optional)*: Result ordering: popularity (default), price_low, price_high, trend, name, rating, or price_drop.
- `price_range` *(optional)*: Price filter as min-max, for example 50-500, or 50- for 50 and above.
- `cursor` *(optional)*: Universal pagination cursor. Send `pagination.next_cursor` from the previous response back verbatim: the API maps it to this endpoint's native `offset` (offset style). You never construct, decode, or look up a cursor. Omit it for page 1.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/store/products?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

### /store/filters — 1cr

Returns the facet groups for one Klarna store (brands and other filters). Feed values into GET /v1/klarna/store/products.

**Parameters**

- `id`: Klarna store UUID, the last segment of storeKrn: 09f4d635-0452-4f63-9455-c45420d95669 for Walmart US. Ids come back on every row of GET /v1/klarna/stores.
- `region` *(optional)*: Shopping region: usa (default), uk, germany, sweden, france, italy, spain, netherlands, austria, ireland, norway, finland, denmark. Changes currency, language, and the merchant set.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/klarna/store/filters?id=<id>" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
